name: No relevant solution skipped
principle: Every solution a matter concerns is named for its own consideration, with few that it does not concern.
state_description: For any change, candidate or request, the solutions it concerns are listed best first, with the parent level of each, so a caller starts one pass per solution and none is skipped.
hints_of_measurement: On labelled cases from a repository's history and from hand-written requests, every gold solution is returned (recall) and most returned solutions are gold (precision), at a cost and time a fan-out can pay.
